Looping you in, Rishi — MedSprint sent their usage forecast and are pushing for a 25% off list for Hosted API on a 12-month committed plan. Quick summary below, full attachments included. Need exec sanction or a clear counter.

Key points:
- Estimated steady-state tokens: ~420M tokens / month after Q2 onboarding (see forecast).
- Requested pricing: 25% off list hosted per-token rate, plus a guaranteed 12-month commit.
- Asks for breach-friendly SLA and 90-day ramp protection clause.

Attachments: MedSprint_HostedAPI_Usage_Forecast_May2028.xlsx, Proposed_Tiered_Pricing_Sheet.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: MedSprint request — deep concession for hosted usage (25%)

Thanks for the context, Ben. I'm escalating to Lauren for executive sanction but wanted to summarize our P&L sensitivity so the ask is clear.

Why this matters: MedSprint is a good strategic reference in the payer-provider space and could surface Redwood to two regional partners. That said, a persistent 25% off list on Hosted API materially reduces our unit margin, especially with KV-cache misses during onboarding.

Numbers (quick ballpark):
- Current list unit margin on hosted tokens: ~38% at expected mix
- 25% concession would reduce margin by ~9–11 percentage points given their expected mix 
- With a 12-month commit and a strict ramp schedule we get upside; without ramp protection this would be loss-leading for months 2–4.

Proposed compromise for approval:
1) Approve 25% concession for first 6 months only, then revert to 12% standard strategic-tier afterward.
2) Include a usage-cliff clause: if actual usage < 60% of forecast across months 3–4, retroactive adjustment to 12% for the initial period.
3) Require a minimum monthly committed spend (MCS) of $85k/month for the first 6 months.

If we get Lauren's sign-off on that structure, Ben — push Legal to include the clawback language and a 30-day audit right.

-Rishi
Head of Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: MedSprint request — deep concession for hosted usage (25%)

Rishi / Ben — I reviewed the numbers and agree we should use this as a strategic concession with tighter guardrails. I approve the following exactly as written below. This is my exec sanction.

Approval (executive sanction):
- Approve a 25% concession off list for Hosted API for MedSprint for an initial 6-month period, effective at contract signature.
- After month 6, price resets to 12% concession for the remainder of the 12-month committed term unless revised by change order.
- Minimum committed spend: $85,000 / month during months 1–6.
- Usage-cliff clause: If usage < 60% of forecast across months 3–4, we will retroactively adjust concession to 12% for months 1–6 and invoice the difference; Procurement must accept audit terms.
- Require Legal to include an audit clause and a standard indemnity; no special data residency exceptions.

Make sure Legal and Finance review the final SOW before signatures. Ben — you have exec clearance to negotiate those guardrails into the doc and proceed to DocuSign. Marissa — please coordinate finance approval for the clawback invoicing workflow if it triggers.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
